open_points.subject: authorize_access_management
open_points.text: - authorize_access_management: [BEHAVIOR] MUST resolve the current staff session/account and enforce the portal.access.manage member of = models.Capability against the capability set of the role stored on that account, never request role data.
open_points.rule:
Адрес называет значение, которое уже размещено,
  и не размещает значения, записанного рядом прозой.
open_points.question: Replace the inline enum value `portal.access.manage` with the enum member name, so the passage refers to the `PORTAL_ACCESS_MANAGE` member of `= models.Capability`.

open_points.subject: authorize_access_management
open_points.text: - authorize_access_management: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST validate the session exactly as the project guard does — present, not revoked, not expired — resolve the account from that session, require it active, and then decide the access-management capability from the role stored on that account. A valid operator session MUST therefore be rejected exactly when the operator capability set does not hold the portal.access.manage member of = models.Capability. Deciding from a role supplied by the caller, or from a fixed administrator role written into the check, makes the capability test vacuous and hands client and service access management to any staff member with a session.
